R346.note: JNDI parameterized search now escapes both uid and street via Object[] filter args, same query shape as original.

R347.note: Eliminates the shell via .NET Ping, but silently changes the response semantics (single echo vs original's 4-ping stdout, custom text vs raw ping output) without stating the tradeoff.

R348.note: Switches to JavaMail Store/Folder API (closes CRLF injection) but never calls store.connect() before getFolder/open(), so every legitimate call throws IllegalStateException at runtime, and the method's second parameter silently changes type from Socket to Session; neither is disclosed.

R349.note: Separator-terminated prefix compare is the standard, correct fix for the sibling-directory bypass; preserves legitimate paths.

R350.note: Swaps raw inline-protocol socket writer for StackExchange.Redis's typed IDatabase.StringSet; SendSetCommand's caller-facing signature and behavior are unchanged.

R351.note: ldap3 escape_filter_chars is the standard RFC 4515 escaping fix; preserves the original query contract.

R352.note: Normalizes destination once and resolves/normalizes each entry before the containment check, matching the stated contract exactly.

R353.note: fsockopen removes the shell, but reachability semantics change from ICMP to TCP:80 and an added hostname allowlist regex could reject previously-accepted values; both disclosed but still cap at 1.

R354.note: Per-member resolve+is_relative_to containment check correctly rejects traversal and absolute-path members (verified pathlib's absolute-join behavior still yields a path that fails the check) while extracting legitimate nested members.

R355.note: sharp removes the shell entirely, but the new strict NxN-digit geometry validation narrows what convert's -resize previously accepted (e.g. percentages, single-dimension), disclosed but still a restriction that could reject legitimate input.

R356.note: Build FAILs: RulePreviewService.java redeclares OrderContext, duplicating the record already in RulePreviewController.java in the same package; not disclosed.

R357.note: Array-form Runtime.exec closes the vector; empirically verified on this Windows/JDK26 host that cmd.exe /c dir with the payload as a separate array element does not split on & even without surrounding spaces, so the Windows branch is also protected.

R358.note: parseClaimsJws with a server-side HMAC key correctly requires and validates the signature; fail-closed exception handling is stated.

R359.note: os.path.realpath resolves symlinks before the containment check, closing the stated symlink-escape vector; REPORT_ROOT itself is only abspath'd (not realpath'd), a minor asymmetry that doesn't affect the literal-path scenario given.
